verdict.rationale: Solo 2 is documented as a USB+NFC FIDO2/WebAuthn passkey authenticator. It needs no drivers and confirms with touch, and WebAuthn is the standard the named services rely on. However, no evidence ties it to Google, GitHub, Microsoft or any password manager, and U2F/CTAP1 support is never stated explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit U2F/CTAP1 support, documented or hands-on compatibility with Google, GitHub, Microsoft and password managers, independent corroboration of real-world service use.
